'''Ronto''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Pilot/Legends|copilot]] who fought in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During his time on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], Ronto flew in a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] with [[Skifter (clone trooper)|Skifter]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We saw them right off, those crustacean-looking fighters. Ronto, my co-pilot, took a few out on our approach through the Im'g'twe Hills.|Skifter, talking about Ronto during the First Battle of Geonosis|<ref name="EGTW AC" />}}
Born on the [[Waterworld/Legends|aquatic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], Ronto was [[Cloning/Legends|grown]] and trained to become a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Ronto, alongside fellow pilot [[Skifter (clone trooper)|Skifter]], were dispatched from their home world to the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis Sector]] to take part in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]. After arriving on the planet in an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|Acclamator-class assault ship]], Ronto's LAAT/i began its transport run towards the [[Im'g'twe Hills/Legends|Im'g'twe Hills]] to drop off a [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] of clone troopers. Before they could reach their destination however, Ronto's gunship came under attack by a group of [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|Nantex-class fighters]]. Ronto managed to destroy a handful of these [[Starship/Legends|ships]], which allowed the LAAT/i to safely land with only slight damage to its back quarter. For the rest of the battle, Ronto kept unloading platoons of clone troopers and shooting down [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]], until he eventually headed back to his Acclamator once the battle had reached its conclusion.<ref name="EGTW AC" />

==Personality and traits==
A clone of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="DB" /> Ronto stood at a height of 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="SWE" /> Being a clone pilot during the [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|phase 1]] era of the Clone Wars, Ronto wore specialized clone trooper armor equipped with a box attached to the chest plate which supplied his helmet with [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]].<ref name="SWE2">{{Film|II}}</ref> During the First Battle of Geonosis, Ronto was shown to be a capable shot, as he took out multiple Nantex-class starfighters.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I liked this slice of Grand Army life, but it felt a bit too similar to the first-person account "Clone Trooper Falls in a Hole&hellip;" That one made the book; with space at a premium, this one didn't.|Jason Fry explains why ''A Soldier's Story: I was a Gunship Pilot'' was cut from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''|<ref name="EGTW AC" />}}
Ronto was originally created by [[Jason Fry]] for ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', in which he was supposed to appear as CT-1155's copilot in ''A Soldier's Story: I was a Gunship Pilot'', although he was cut from the book alongside the story he appeared in. On [[May 6]]th [[2014]], ''A Soldier's Story: I was a Gunship Pilot'' was brought back in the form of one of the many cut stories from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'', in the eight issue of the [[StarWars.com]] blog [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut, Part 8: Tales of the Clone Wars'']]. In this blog, Jason Fry and [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] explain that the story was too familiar to ''Clone Trooper Falls in a Hole...'', which is why it was cut.<ref name="EGTW AC" />
